# SUDU DUWA AQUA PRODUCTS (PVT) LTD

> Sri Lanka's Premier Science-Driven Specific Pathogen Free (SPF) Prawn Hatchery & Nauplii Center, located in Chilaw. Supplying high-survival Litopenaeus Vannamei nauplii, post-larvae (PL), and commercial aquaculture consulting across Sri Lanka.

## Key Information
- **Company Name**: SUDU DUWA AQUA PRODUCTS (PVT) LTD
- **Managing Director & Founder**: Selvarajah Pradeeban (BSc in Food Science & Technology, Specialization in Aquaculture)
- **Headquarters**: 136/52/B/1 Sangathddana, Puttalam Road, Chilaw, Sri Lanka
- **Operational Centers**:
  1. Sudu Duwa Aqua Project – Naupilia Center (No 08, Ambakandawilla, Chilaw)
  2. St. Rogus Prawn Hatchery (Ambakandawilla, Chilaw)
- **Broodstock Origin**: Imported genetically superior SPF broodstock from Shrimp Improvement Systems (SIS), Florida, USA
- **Target Species**: Litopenaeus Vannamei (Pacific White Shrimp / Vannamei Prawn)
- **Certifications**: Specific Pathogen Free (SPF) Certified, PCR Pathogen Screened (WSSV, EHP, IHHNV, EMS/AHPND)
- **Primary Contacts**:
  - Office Phone: +94 32 205 5422
  - Mobile & WhatsApp: +94 70 666 5295 / +94 77 806 5295
  - Email: suduaqua726@gmail.com / Sududuwa372@gmail.com

## Primary Offerings & Services
- **Litopenaeus Vannamei Nauplii**: High-vigor, disease-free seed bred from USA SIS broodstock ready for nursery and hatchery rearing.
- **Vannamei Post-Larvae (PL)**: Acclimated, robust post-larvae ready for high-density pond stocking with high survival rates.
- **Aquaculture Consultation**: Expert guidance on farm pond preparation, biofloc and water cleaning technology, and biosecure farm management.
- **Water Quality Testing**: Laboratory analysis of salinity, pH, micro/macro minerals, dissolved oxygen, and Vibrio counts.
- **Biosecurity & Pathogen Screening**: PCR testing protocols to ensure pathogen-free batches before pond stocking.
